help.content:
========
Synopsis
========

Renames collection element identifiers using a mapping from a file.

===========
Description
===========

This tool changes the element identifiers (names) in a collection without modifying the datasets themselves. The new identifiers are read from a file you provide.

Three mapping modes are available:

========
Examples
========

**Simple text file — positional renaming**

Each line in the text file replaces the identifier at the same position in the collection. Given a collection::

 List:  sampleA, sampleB, sampleC

and a text file::

 Alpha
 Beta
 Gamma

the output is::

 List:  Alpha, Beta, Gamma

.. class:: infomark

The text file must have exactly as many lines as the collection has elements (when **Ensure strict mapping** is enabled).

-------

**Two-column tabular file — lookup renaming**

The first column contains the current identifier, the second column the new one. Order does not matter::

 sampleB    Beta
 sampleC    Gamma
 sampleA    Alpha

Output::

 List:  Alpha, Beta, Gamma

-------

**Extended tabular — choose which columns to use**

Works like the two-column mode, but the file may have additional columns. You select which column holds the original identifiers and which holds the new ones.

-------

.. image:: ${static_path}/images/tools/collection_ops/relabel.svg
  :alt: Relabel collection element identifiers from a file
  :width: 500

-------

.. class:: warningmark

Valid identifiers must contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), numbers (0-9), dash (-), underscore (_), dot (.), space ( ) and comma (,). Other characters are not allowed.

.. class:: infomark

This tool will create new history datasets copied from your input collections but your quota usage will not increase.
